_help: All the short text on the site lives here.
Easiest way to edit: run `npm run dev`, open the site, press E (or click Edit at the bottom right), click any outlined text and type, then Save.
You can also edit this file by hand. Keep the quotes and commas as they are.

homelab.services: `link` makes a card open a guide (a guide id like "pihole", optionally with "#section"). `url` is the tool's own website, shown as a small ↗ on the card. `icon` is a file name in public/icons/ without .svg. `groups` turns a card into a full-width card with sections of apps inside (like Server): each group has a name and apps, and each app has a name, role, icon and url.
about.cv: put your CV in public/ (e.g. public/cv.pdf) and write its file name here ("cv.pdf"). Leave it empty to hide the button.

site.name: Dimitrios Kontoulis

homelab.title: Homelab
homelab.intro: This section is the documentation of my homelab and generally my self-hosting journey. You can find the tools tools and services I use, how I set them up and how I kept (and still keep on) breaking it. Some could say that this has indeed become my little hobby. Always working on maintaining it and keeping it in one piece.

services.name: Pi-hole
services.text: Blocks ads and trackers for every device on my network, at the DNS level.

services.name: Tailscale
services.text: Private VPN, so my devices keep using Pi-hole even when I'm away from home.

services.name: Server
services.text: My main machine. Everything here runs in Docker, with Traefik in front.
